approximateCoordinates.basis: Historic-building site vicinity supported by Wikimedia photo metadata; not an independently surveyed building-centroid measurement.

purpose: Reproducible, rights-documented reference intake for P3.3 Ahsan Manzil reconstruction review, including an unrectified aerial view for qualitative roof-plane context.

dimensions.basis: Published footprint dimensions in the existing parameter register conflict and are not independent surveyed control measurements.
dimensions.mustNotInferFrom: image pixel dimensions, perspective photographs, file camera coordinates, or visual estimates

footprint.requirement: Trace the building's actual footprint and reconcile Rangmahal/Andarmahal orientation before accepting map placement or whole-model massing.

model.reason: The reference photos are not a calibrated photogrammetry set; independent surveyed dimensions/control points and geometry/texture QA acceptance remain outstanding.

licensePolicy: These reference images are licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Preserve creator attribution, link the license, disclose any changes, and comply with share-alike terms for redistributed/adapted material. This metadata file does not grant any rights beyond the individual source licenses.

sources.title: Ahsan Manzil 01.jpg
sources.creator: Azim Khan Ronnie
supports: qualitative roof-plane segmentation and roof tone
relative arrangement of front stair, central dome and side wings
broad stepped footprint and roof-section relationships
notUsableFor: true roof-plane dimensions without aerial-camera calibration and orthorectification
texture baking or facade projection without per-pixel camera calibration
exact facade heights or hidden surfaces

viewAssessment.viewpoint: Oblique aerial/drone view with the building roof visible; it is not a nadir orthophoto.
occlusions: surrounding trees, adjacent buildings and perspective distortion affect visible roof edges
viewAssessment.geometryUse: Qualitative roof-plane segmentation and broad stepped-massing comparison only; no scale or angles are derived from the image.
notSufficientFor: orthographic roof plan or traced footprint
direct texture projection or atlas baking
viewAssessment.assessedFrom: Wikimedia Commons file-page metadata and the unrectified aerial preview; original file metadata records the published SHA-1 and byte length, while the downloaded 1280×853 Wikimedia thumbnail is independently checked for JPEG format and dimensions and receives its own computed SHA-256.

acceptanceGates: For original-mode sources, bytes must match published byte length and SHA-1. The explicitly marked aerial thumbnail mode instead validates the fixed thumb.wikimedia.org URL, JPEG format and 1280×853 dimensions, computes a local SHA-256 for the downloaded derivative, and keeps original-file SHA-1/size metadata separate.
Compute and store SHA-256 locally for every downloaded source file and include the attribution/license metadata in the same artifact.
The source photo set supports manual facade/massing review only; camera calibration and independent surveyed dimensions remain unknown.
Any texture projection must record camera pose, visible-pixel mask, occlusion policy and source-image attribution.
Do not mark architectural fidelity or release readiness as passed from a successful CI run, a valid GLB, or a three-photo reference pack alone.
The 2019 aerial image is an unrectified oblique view: use it only for qualitative roof-plane and stepped-massing review; do not infer scale, surveyed dimensions, or UV projection from it.
